light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));"><b>Model Notes&nbsp;</b></span></div><div><ul><li>Species is obtained through the BREED entity to avoid storing redundant species information in PET.</li><li>An Unknown/Mixed breed should be provided for each species when a pet’s exact breed is unavailable.</li><li>age is a derived attribute calculated from date_of_birth; it is not stored in the database.</li><li>Each pet has exactly one owner, breed, listing status, and location.</li><li>Each pet must have at least one photo but may have zero or more medical records.</li><li>FAVORITES is a many-to-many relationship between APP_USER and PET.</li><li>Each conversation concerns exactly one pet and has one starter, one listing owner, and one or more messages.</li><li>The conversation’s listing owner is obtained from the owner of the related pet, avoiding redundant owner information.</li><li>Owner and adopter are roles performed by APP_USER, not separate entity types, because one user can perform both roles.</li><li>Foreign keys are omitted from the conceptual ER diagram and added during conversion to the relational schema.</li></ul></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="300" text-align: center;

ul.li: Species is obtained through the BREED entity to avoid storing redundant species information in PET.
An Unknown/Mixed breed should be provided for each species when a pet’s exact breed is unavailable.
age is a derived attribute calculated from date_of_birth; it is not stored in the database.
Each pet has exactly one owner, breed, listing status, and location.
Each pet must have at least one photo but may have zero or more medical records.
FAVORITES is a many-to-many relationship between APP_USER and PET.
Each conversation concerns exactly one pet and has one starter, one listing owner, and one or more messages.
The conversation’s listing owner is obtained from the owner of the related pet, avoiding redundant owner information.
Owner and adopter are roles performed by APP_USER, not separate entity types, because one user can perform both roles.
Foreign keys are omitted from the conceptual ER diagram and added during conversion to the relational schema.
